lines.text: Jesus Christ was portrayed as crucified before the Galatians, who are asked how they received the Spirit.
They started in the Spirit, are asked if they now finish in the flesh, and God works miracles among them.
All tribes will be blessed through Abraham, but all who rely on works of the law are under a curse.
Christ redeemed us so Abraham's blessing would come to the Egyptians, and we receive the Spirit by faith.
